dslRule:
<!id: add-module-info-check>
<!description: Add module-info check to instanceof conditions for ICompilationUnit and IClassFile elements when handling Java 9+ modules.>
<!severity: WARNING>
<!map ELEMENT_TYPE: "org.eclipse.jdt.core.ICompilationUnit" => "org.eclipse.jdt.core.ICompilationUnit", "org.eclipse.jdt.core.IClassFile" => "org.eclipse.jdt.core.IClassFile">

$element instanceof #{ELEMENT_TYPE} :: sourceVersionGE(9)
=> $element instanceof #{ELEMENT_TYPE} && !org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.JavaModelUtil.isModuleInfo((#{ELEMENT_TYPE_VALUE}) $element)
;;
summary: Adds a check `!JavaModelUtil.isModuleInfo(element)` to existing `instanceof ICompilationUnit` or `instanceof IClassFile` expressions, targeting Java 9+ projects.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
